title: Show the account's folders on Sources

proofs.run: on the owner's installed build (or a private copy of the owner's data folder, read as counts only): Settings, Replies, Sources with the one working account; read `rows mac-settings-replies.sources` through the control socket
proofs.pass: one row kind=account for the account, no no-account footnote row (mac-settings-replies.no-account absent), and mail_folder rows whose `enabled` is true for INBOX and the Sent folder and false for every other folder

gap: Still missing: the lead's hidden run of proof 7 (python3 checks/realcore-check.py <bundle> --slice-sources on a hidden test copy): it adds the local IMAP account as slice2 does, opens Settings, Replies, Sources, reads `rows mac-settings-replies.sources` and prints PASS lines for one account row, enabled mail_folder rows Inbox and Sent only (Archive listed and off), no `no-account` footnote, no mail text in the rows. The slice and its self-test (7 broken copies, each red) exist and have not run against an app. The fixture-core case sources-tiles-calendars-scope prints its PASS line (proof 6).
